messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 1.3.4

1.3.4. Risks due to surfaces, edges or angles Insofar as their purpose allows, accessible parts of the machinery must have no sharp edges, no sharp angles and no rough surfaces likely to cause injury.

response.text:
accessible parts of the machinery | mustNotHave | sharp edges | insofar as their purpose allows | must have no sharp edges
accessible parts of the machinery | mustNotHave | sharp angles | insofar as their purpose allows | no sharp angles
accessible parts of the machinery | mustNotHave | rough surfaces likely to cause injury | insofar as their purpose allows | no rough surfaces likely to cause injury
